ShortDescription.Value: Group buildings into collections and fill a whole city block with them in one click.

Publish.LongDescription:
Collections Builder does two things: it lets you keep your own **collections** of buildings, and it uses them to **build whole city blocks** in one go.
**Collections** - A collection is a named list of buildings you pick yourself: a style, a theme, a street mood, anything. - With the panel open and a collection selected, Shift+click a building in Find It or in the game's asset menu to add it, or add everything Find It is currently showing with one button. - With the "Tag collections in Find It" option on, every collection is also a **Find It tag**, so you can browse it straight from Find It. - Browse a collection as cards (thumbnail, name, lot size, level), search it, filter it, and remove buildings you no longer want.
**Block builder** - Click a block surrounded by roads, or draw a polygon, and pick a collection. - The mod lays buildings from that collection along every sidewalk, facing the street, with corner buildings on the corners when the collection has them. It also handles curved streets. - Filter by lot width, depth and level, and set the density (how much of the street front gets built). - Preview the result as a transparent plan, press Reshuffle for another random layout with the same rules, and press Build when you like it. No zoning needed, and growables placed this way are protected from being condemned. - Optional trees in the leftover space inside the block.
**Mixing two collections** - Fill a block from two collections at once and choose the proportion with a slider, for example 70 % of one style and 30 % of another.
**Overlap** - Street lengths are rarely a multiple of the 8 m lot grid, so a strict layout leaves gaps at street ends and along curves. - With "Overlap per joint" (0.5 to 2 m), neighbouring buildings may overlap each other by up to that much, so they always touch and the leftover goes to the corner instead of showing as gaps between buildings. Existing buildings are never removed or overlapped. - Overlap needs the **Anarchy** mod: the builder turns Anarchy on while its tab is open and turns it back off when you leave (only if it was the one that turned it on). Set it to Off to build without overlap.
Find It is optional (it is only used for adding buildings and for tags). Early version (0.1.x): feedback and bug reports are welcome on GitHub.
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.3.0 - Click a building in a collection to place it directly with the game's placement tool, no Find It needed. - While placing a building from the selected collection, the Reshuffle key (T by default) switches to another random building from the ones shown in the Collections tab.
0.2.0 - Editable polygon, like the game's areas: drag a corner to move it (it still snaps to the sidewalk), drag the dot in the middle of a side to add a corner, right-click a corner to remove it. The selection and preview update when you release.
0.1.40 - first test release (private). - With overlap enabled, neighbouring buildings along a sidewalk touch each other (overlapping at most the configured value) instead of leaving gaps between them; any leftover stays at the corner. - Curved streets: the short segments of a curve are filled, with the overlap measured at the facade, so buildings follow the curve with far fewer empty spots (some very tight curves still leave gaps). - Narrow blocks: facing streets are both built, with backs allowed to overlap. - Empty facade cells between buildings are filled as a last resort with a one-cell-wide building.
